title: UltimateFoxes
description: This plugin will add tameable foxes on your game!!
body:
**UltimateFoxes – Tameable Foxes for Minecraft**

UltimateFoxes is a fun and lightweight Minecraft plugin that adds fully tameable foxes to your server, giving players a new companion to explore and interact with.

With simple commands and smooth gameplay integration, players can enjoy owning loyal fox pets that make survival and adventures even more exciting.

**✨ Features:**

- Adds tameable foxes to the server
- Easy-to-use command system
- Lightweight and optimized
- Survival-friendly gameplay
- Fun companion system for players
- Simple setup and configuration

**🦊 Command:**

- `/ufox` – Main plugin command

**💡 Why use UltimateFoxes?**

Foxes in vanilla Minecraft are difficult to interact with and cannot fully function as player companions. UltimateFoxes enhances the experience by allowing players to tame and enjoy fox pets in a more interactive and enjoyable way.

**📌 Perfect for:**

- SMP servers
- Survival servers
- Community servers
- Roleplay servers

**Bring adorable and loyal fox companions to your Minecraft server with UltimateFoxes!**
